title: Slime
tagline: Vote on DeFi strategies, fund winners, earn rewards - powered by futarchy defai
description:
The Problem We Solve

KOL Accountability Crisis: Crypto influencers shill strategies with zero skin in the game
Information Asymmetry: Users can't tell good strategies from bad ones
No Consequences: Wrong predictions cost followers money while KOLs face nothing
Manual Execution: Even good strategies require manual work to implement

Our Solution

💰 Stake Capital: Predictors must buy YES/NO shares with real money
🔍 Transparent Positions: All predictions are public on-chain
🤖 Automated Execution: Winning strategies get funded and executed by agents
📊 Market Wisdom: Prices aggregate collective intelligence
⚡ Fast & Cheap: Built on Hedera for instant settlement
